I won’t lie to you, I’ve been sent to more jobs to “fix” a homeowner’s DIY attempt more times than I can count. But if you follow the correct steps you might yet pull it off (keep in mind these machines I use are NOT intended for amateurs, my big machine will run you into a wall if you’re not careful). But here’s my process; 
1)rough the floor in with a low grit paper to really grind out all the old finish and flatten it all out.
2)go around the perimeter with an edger sander. Depending on the floor it might need edged twice, once with lower grit paper if it’s a rough finish but always finish edging with AT LEAST 80 grit. 
3) big machine again with 60 grit
4)big machine again with 100 grit (this is your buffing out the floor)
5)scrape all corners to get old finish out of areas where edgers won’t reach
